manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Shows a tossed ball with zero velocity at the top but constant downward acceleration.
manifest.description: A side‑by‑side view of a ball moving on a height ruler and its velocity‑time graph. Arrows indicate velocity, acceleration and gravitational force. Readouts display the current values and the motion state.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
